acceptance_criteria: Explicit legal phase transitions and terminal-state handling.
Invalid commands are atomic and do not mutate the input snapshot.
Three base manual Taps; Card Pop during Cast does not consume a Tap.
Player Vigil/Block/Flasks/Ink/Spark and enemy Vigor/Block obey ADRs.
Enemy Block expires at the start of the enemy phase; Player Block expires at the start of the next player turn.
Two-intent forecast is deterministic and the resolved intent is exactly the forecast head.
Strike, Ash Row, Stone Seed, Stain, Fog, Seal, Brand, Surge, Snatch and Curse behavior is correct.
Seal duration and all enemy board effects respect sealed columns, including pending incoming rows.
Wall/Overflow behavior delegates to EFB-002 BoardEngine and lethal overflow stops remaining scheduled rises.
Run seed and combat rules version are bound into stable replay checkpoint digests.
Command replay yields identical per-step checkpoint digests and records rejected commands without changing state.
No Android/Compose dependencies or legacy prototype code/assets are imported.
review_focus: Adversarially inspect all phase and command transitions, especially terminal transitions and simultaneous lethal Tap resolution.
Check ordering of chip damage, enemy Block, Brand Vigil cost and enemy defeat.
Verify Seal timing (4 internal ticks to provide 3 complete future turns), sealed incoming-row preservation and interactions with Ash Row/Stain/Stone Seed/Brand.
Check Surge with one or two overflows, Flask consumption and stop-on-lethal behavior.
Inspect the EFB-002 BoardEngine adapter for sealed incoming columns.
Review CardPop semantics against the game spec and ensure it does not spend a Tap or decrement Fog.
Check intent forecast/cursor parity, seed/rules version digest completeness and replay determinism.
Review immutable snapshots and all integer bounds/overflow behavior.
Confirm Snatch/Curse are intentionally emitted as EFB-004 integration events, not falsely claimed as full hand/discard mutation.
Verify tests have independent expected values and meaningful edge coverage; do not rely only on builder's report.
known_boundaries: Card definitions, deck draw/discard and effect DSL belong to EFB-004; Snatch/Curse are integration events only.
Enemy catalogue/scaling and content-specific intent sequences belong to later content increments.
Android presentation/device testing is outside this pure JVM increment.
The Product Owner explicitly excludes legacy prototype source/assets; no legacy material is reused.
